title: Keo dai free tier ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude
steps: Hieu ro: local Qwen 3B khong ngang Claude/GPT — dung de giam so tin nhan cloud.
Viec de (dich, tom tat, viet lai, checklist, draft): tab AI local + Cache.
Viec kho: tab Quota → Copy cloud brief → Open ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude → paste 1 lan.
Batch nhieu viec nho thanh 1 prompt cloud (Copy batch template).
Xoay vong: het limit Claude (~5h) → Gemini → ChatGPT (hoac nguoc lai).
Doi chu de tren cloud: chat moi + chi mang brief, khong paste ca lich su dai.
Xem Quota stats: cache hit / local gen = so request cloud da tranh duoc.
